rest.excellent: Greater ease in connection, with {day} the softest of them.
rest.good: Recovery comes easily this week. Take it on {day}.
rest.fair: Rest is available but has to be chosen. {day} is easiest.
rest.poor: Rest will feel effortful. Protect it anyway.

communication.title: Creative Spark
communication.excellent: Your ideas find support. Say the thing on {day}.
communication.good: Words land well this week, {day} especially.
communication.fair: Be plainer than usual. {day} is the clearest window.
communication.poor: Expect to repeat yourself. Put it in writing.

money.title: Steady Progress
money.excellent: Small steps create big shifts, and {day} compounds them.
money.good: Practical matters move. {day} is the day to file it.
money.fair: Progress is slow but real. {day} is the best of it.
money.poor: Hold the line rather than extending it.

relationships.title: Shared Ground
relationships.excellent: Deeper trust is on offer. {day} is the day to ask.
relationships.good: People meet you halfway this week, {day} most of all.
relationships.fair: Go first and go gently. {day} is the kindest window.
relationships.poor: Give conversations more room than they seem to need.

study.title: Deep Focus
study.excellent: Difficult material goes in cleanly, {day} above all.
study.good: A good week to learn something structural. Start {day}.
study.fair: Focus comes in bursts. {day} holds the longest one.
study.poor: Review rather than take on anything new.

travel.title: Open Road
travel.excellent: Movement agrees with you. {day} is the day to go.
travel.good: A change of place would help. {day} is clearest.
travel.fair: Travel light and leave margin. {day} is smoothest.

nakshatra.rises: A week of illumination and gentle momentum.
nakshatra.settles: A week that grows quieter and easier to read.
nakshatra.turns: A week of sharp changes in visibility.
nakshatra.holds: A week of steady, unhurried clarity.
nakshatra.builds: A week that comes into focus around its middle.

tithi.rises: A week that fills out as it goes.
tithi.settles: A week of completion rather than beginning.
tithi.turns: A week of full days and empty ones in close succession.
tithi.holds: A week with an even, generous weight to it.
tithi.builds: A week that gathers toward something in the middle.

yoga.rises: A week that opens up more the further in you go.
yoga.settles: A week that resolves more kindly than it starts.
yoga.turns: A week of uneven footing and sudden ease.
yoga.holds: A week of quiet, reliable good will.
yoga.builds: A week whose best hours sit at its centre.

karana.rises: A week that firms up as it goes.
karana.settles: A week that asks less of you by the end.
karana.turns: A week that changes its mind more than once.
karana.holds: A week of level ground throughout.
karana.builds: A week that consolidates around midweek.

weekday.rises: A week that finds its stride late.
weekday.settles: A week that slows into something more sustainable.
weekday.holds: A week with a consistent beat to it.
weekday.builds: A week that hits its pace in the middle.

tarabala.rises: A week of widening luck and easier timing.
tarabala.settles: A week whose difficulties recede as it goes.
tarabala.turns: A week of mixed fortune, unevenly spread.
tarabala.holds: A week of consistent, undramatic favour.
tarabala.builds: A week whose luckiest hours are at its centre.

chandrabala.rises: A week that warms as it goes.
chandrabala.settles: A week that grows calmer and more inward.
chandrabala.builds: A week that deepens toward its middle.

transit_aspect.rises: A week of gathering support from outside you.
transit_aspect.settles: A week where the pressure eases off.
transit_aspect.turns: A week of help and hindrance in quick alternation.
transit_aspect.builds: A week whose support concentrates midweek.

clear.rises: Trust what feels light, and let it carry you.
clear.settles: Let things land rather than chasing them.
clear.turns: Stay loose about plans and firm about priorities.
clear.holds: Keep the routine that is already working.
clear.builds: Put the important thing in the middle of the week.

nakshatra.rises: Trust what feels light, release what feels heavy.
nakshatra.settles: Choose the gentler option where there is one.
nakshatra.turns: Do not read a hard day as a verdict.
nakshatra.holds: Sameness is not stagnation this week.
nakshatra.builds: Save the delicate conversations for midweek.

tithi.rises: Finish something before starting the next thing.
tithi.settles: Close what is open rather than opening more.
tithi.turns: Expect some days to give less than they promise.
tithi.holds: Small consistent effort beats a single push.
tithi.builds: Let the early days be preparation.

yoga.rises: Let the awkward hours pass rather than fighting them.
yoga.settles: Difficulty early is not a pattern for the week.
yoga.turns: Keep a margin around anything that matters.
yoga.holds: Work with the grain, not against it.
yoga.builds: Protect the middle of the week from interruption.

karana.rises: Leave slack in the schedule for the rough patches.
karana.settles: Do not commit to firm times on the difficult days.
karana.turns: Half-days will serve you better than whole ones.
karana.holds: Steady, and unremarkable, is the plan.

weekday.rises: Move the demanding tasks toward the end of the week.
weekday.settles: The early days will ask more than the later ones.
weekday.turns: Match the task to the day rather than the reverse.
weekday.holds: Any day will do; pick one and start.
weekday.builds: Midweek is where the weight belongs.

tarabala.rises: Timing improves as the week goes on. Wait where you can.
tarabala.settles: Let the harder days pass without conclusions.
tarabala.turns: Some days are simply not for deciding.
tarabala.holds: Nothing forces itself this week, in either direction.
tarabala.builds: Hold the decision until the middle of the week.

chandrabala.rises: Your own mood is the variable. Watch it, do not obey it.
chandrabala.settles: Give yourself more quiet than usual.
chandrabala.turns: Feeling and fact will disagree. Prefer fact.
chandrabala.holds: An even mood is worth protecting.
chandrabala.builds: Rest early so the middle has something to spend.

transit_aspect.rises: Outside pressure eases. Use the space when it comes.
transit_aspect.settles: What has been pressing on you lets go this week.
transit_aspect.turns: Others' timing, not yours, is what shifts.
